patch.value: Eliminate the last source any with real SDK handler context types

Replace the 5 remaining source any annotations on SDK handler contexts in index.ts (preflight, two importers, exporter, onWrite hook) with the real SDK context types from @unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/authoring, imported type-only from the same subpath the file already imports ExtensionApi from so standalone installs gain no runtime module edge.

No any remains in index.ts (grep for : any | as any | <any> | any[] prints nothing); npm run build, npm test, and npx tsc --noEmit all pass; changelog:check reports up to date; pm jira --help lists all subcommands and pm list/health stay intact after install (real activation proof); behaviour unchanged (typing refactor only).

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: SDK handler context types resolved in node_modules/@unbrained/pm-cli/dist/core/extensions/extension-types.d.ts and re-exported type-only from @unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/authoring: PreflightOverrideContext (preflight, extends CommandHandlerContext + decision), ImportExportContext (importer + exporter, extends PortableWorkspaceContext with options/args/global/pm_root/sdk), OnWriteHookContext (onWrite hook, with path/scope/op/item_id/item_type/before/after/changed_fields). The 5 any sites replaced: (1) api.registerPreflight ctx: any -> PreflightOverrideContext; (2) api.registerImporter jira ctx: any -> ImportExportContext; (3) api.registerImporter jira-sync ctx: any -> ImportExportContext; (4) api.registerExporter jira ctx: any -> ImportExportContext; (5) api.hooks.onWrite hookCtx: any -> OnWriteHookContext. OnWriteHookContext is structurally assignable to decidePushOnWrite's loose {path?;scope?;op?} param, so it flows through with no cast and the runtime guard is retained. Preflight defensive optional-chaining + ?? fallbacks kept as no-ops (comment added) rather than deleted. Contract gotchas respected: --json stays on ctx.global (not ctx.options) and multi-word flags read camelCased.
